title: Neonomics and Movitz Payments strengthen Pay by Bank security
message_html: Neonomics and Movitz Payments strengthen Pay by Bank security ...
snippet: Neonomics, the European open banking and Pay by Bank provider, has integrated Movitz Payments' Verification of Payee (VoP) technology into Nello Pay in Finland, with plans to expand to Sweden, Denmark and Norway in 2027.

title: Airtm and BVNK team on direct wallet payments in emerging markets
